query: SELECT snapshot.snapshot_id,snapshot.fetched_at,snapshot.content_type,(SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM ingestion_source_observations observation WHERE observation.snapshot_id=snapshot.snapshot_id) AS observed_at FROM ingestion_snapshots snapshot WHERE snapshot.snapshot_id=(SELECT snapshot_id FROM ingestion_snapshots ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
